about: One entry per case. Load 'base' first as a full set (null: start empty), then apply 'file'. A valid case lists what the view holds afterwards; a refused case gives the first refusal's code and exact message, and the view is unchanged.

messages.wrong-kind: Not an embeddings-tumbler data set: "kind" must be "embeddings-tumbler/data".
messages.schema-version: Data schema version {found} is not supported; this viewer reads schema version {supported}.
messages.invalid-field: Field "{field}" is missing or not valid.
messages.vector-file-path: Vector file "{file}" must be a plain file name in the same folder as the data file.
messages.endpoint-is-address: "provenance.endpoint" must name the embedding route, not give a network address.
messages.count-mismatch: "count" is {count} but the data has {found} point records.
messages.duplicate-id: Point id "{id}" appears more than once.
messages.block-length: Vector block is {found} bytes; expected {count} points x {dimension} dimensions x 4 bytes = {expected} bytes.
messages.non-finite: Vector of point "{id}" contains a value that is not a finite number.
messages.append-without-base: Cannot append: the view holds no data set yet. Send a full set first.
messages.model-mismatch: Cannot append: model "{found}" differs from the view's model "{expected}". One view shows one model.
messages.dimension-mismatch: Cannot append: dimension {found} differs from the view's dimension {expected}.
messages.reduction-mismatch: Cannot append: reduction "{found}" differs from the view's reduction "{expected}".
messages.id-exists: Cannot append: point id "{id}" is already in the view.
